hooks.name: Commit after completed task
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, commit only the files that task changed with a conventional commit message.

action.prompt: The task just completed. If this workspace is a git repository (check with `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree`), commit the work: run `git status --short`, stage only the files this task changed by name (never `git add -A` or `git add .`), and commit with a Conventional Commits message (feat, fix, docs, test, chore, refactor) that describes what the task did, for example `feat(core): add session serializer`. Do not push. Do not commit .env files, node_modules, dist or coverage. If it is not a git repository or there is nothing to commit, do nothing and say so in one sentence.
